INSCRYPTION-CREATURE.title: Creature
INSCRYPTION-CREATURE.description: Takes a lane. Takes the hits of the enemy in its lane. At the end of your turn, strikes that enemy. If a lane has no creature, its enemy hits you.
INSCRYPTION-CANINETRIBE.title: Canine
INSCRYPTION-CANINETRIBE.description: A tribe. Canine Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-HOOVEDTRIBE.title: Hooved
INSCRYPTION-HOOVEDTRIBE.description: A tribe. Hooved Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-REPTILETRIBE.title: Reptile
INSCRYPTION-REPTILETRIBE.description: A tribe. Reptile Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-AVIANTRIBE.title: Avian
INSCRYPTION-AVIANTRIBE.description: A tribe. Avian Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-INSECTTRIBE.title: Insect
INSCRYPTION-INSECTTRIBE.description: A tribe. Insect Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-SQUIRRELTRIBE.title: Squirrel
INSCRYPTION-SQUIRRELTRIBE.description: A tribe. Squirrel Totems give their sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-EVERYTRIBE.title: Every Tribe
INSCRYPTION-EVERYTRIBE.description: Counts as every tribe, so every Totem gives its sigil to this creature.
INSCRYPTION-AIRBORNE.title: Airborne
INSCRYPTION-AIRBORNE.description: Flies over blockers: its strikes ignore Block.
INSCRYPTION-MIGHTYLEAP.title: Mighty Leap
INSCRYPTION-MIGHTYLEAP.description: Can block flying enemies. Flying enemies' attacks pass over other creatures.
INSCRYPTION-BIFURCATEDSTRIKE.title: Bifurcated Strike
INSCRYPTION-BIFURCATEDSTRIKE.description: Strikes the lanes on either side of its own instead of its own lane.
INSCRYPTION-TRIFURCATEDSTRIKE.title: Trifurcated Strike
INSCRYPTION-TRIFURCATEDSTRIKE.descriptio: Strikes its own lane and the lanes on either side.
INSCRYPTION-LEADER.title: Leader
INSCRYPTION-LEADER.description: Creatures in the lanes beside it have +3 attack.
INSCRYPTION-STINKY.title: Stinky
INSCRYPTION-STINKY.description: The enemy in its lane deals 3 less damage per hit.
INSCRYPTION-SHARPQUILLS.title: Sharp Quills
INSCRYPTION-SHARPQUILLS.description: When an enemy hits it, deals 3 damage back.
INSCRYPTION-TOUCHOFDEATH.title: Touch of Death
INSCRYPTION-TOUCHOFDEATH.description: Kills any normal enemy it damages. Elites and bosses are immune.
INSCRYPTION-WATERBORNE.title: Waterborne
INSCRYPTION-WATERBORNE.description: Submerges on the enemy turn: it can't be hit, and the enemy in its lane hits you instead.
INSCRYPTION-BURROWER.title: Burrower
INSCRYPTION-BURROWER.description: When an enemy attacks an empty lane, it moves there and takes the hit.
INSCRYPTION-GUARDIAN.title: Guardian
INSCRYPTION-GUARDIAN.description: At the start of the enemy turn, if its lane's enemy isn't attacking, it moves to block an attacker in an empty lane.
INSCRYPTION-SPRINTER.title: Sprinter
INSCRYPTION-SPRINTER.description: After it strikes, it moves one lane, turning back at the edge or when blocked.
INSCRYPTION-MANYLIVES.title: Many Lives
INSCRYPTION-MANYLIVES.description: Sacrificing it pays its Blood, but it stays on the board.
INSCRYPTION-WORTHYSACRIFICE.title: Worthy Sacrifice
INSCRYPTION-BONEKING.title: Bone King
INSCRYPTION-BONEKING.description: When it dies, gain 4 [gold]Bones[/gold] instead of 1.
INSCRYPTION-UNKILLABLE.title: Unkillable
INSCRYPTION-UNKILLABLE.description: When it dies, a copy of its card returns to your hand.
INSCRYPTION-CORPSEEATER.title: Corpse Eater
INSCRYPTION-CORPSEEATER.description: While in your hand (it Retains): when one of your creatures is killed (not sacrificed), this is summoned into its lane for free.
INSCRYPTION-FROZENAWAY.title: Frozen Away
INSCRYPTION-FROZENAWAY.description: When it is killed, the [gold]Opossum[/gold] frozen inside takes its lane.
INSCRYPTION-TERRAIN.title: Terrain
INSCRYPTION-TERRAIN.description: Holds a lane. Cannot be sacrificed.
